item.title: Toptal: Applied AI Engineers for telecommunications company
item.description:
Headquarters:

Summary

The Senior AI Professional will help design, develop, and optimize production-grade agentic AI solutions. This role complements an existing platform engineering team and focuses on turning AI concepts into reliable, scalable software rather than purely research-oriented work.

General information

This engagement requires deep hands-on expertise in machine learning and applied AI, with a strong emphasis on prompt optimization, model behavior, agent orchestration, and evaluation. The work will involve collaborating with platform engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders to improve AI quality, reliability, and performance in production environments.

Tasks and Deliverables

Design, develop, and optimize production-grade agentic AI solutions.

Run meaningful evaluations to improve prompts, model behavior, orchestration, reliability, and performance in production.

Required experience

  • Deep expertise in machine learning and applied AI.
  • Experience building and deploying production-level AI/ML services.
  • Strong software engineering and coding skills.
  • Experience developing or optimizing LLM- and agent-based applications.
  • Strong knowledge of prompt engineering and optimization.
  • Strong knowledge of model evaluation and benchmarking.
  • Strong knowledge of AI quality, reliability, and performance measurement.
  • Strong knowledge of agent behavior and orchestration.
  • Ability to design and run meaningful evaluations and interpret results.
  • Experience with APIs, data pipelines, backend systems, and AI platforms.
  • Familiarity with modern AI tools, frameworks, and cloud environments.
  • Ability to collaborate with platform engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders.
  • Strong communication skills and experience delivering maintainable, production-quality solutions.

Nice to have:

  • Python experience.
  • Background as an Applied AI Scientist, AI Engineer, or Machine Learning Engineer.
  • Engagement highlights
  • Own a defined production AI workstream with direct impact on reliability and scale.
  • Work closely with an existing platform engineering team on applied AI delivery.
  • Focus on production-grade AI implementation rather than purely research-oriented work.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toptal-applied-ai-engineers-for-telecommunications-company

item.title: Toptal: Salesforce Developers with AI-Assisted Coding Experience
item.description:
Headquarters:

We are looking for Salesforce Developers for a global company. Their goal is to accelerate Salesforce delivery across Flows, Lightning Web Components, and Apex while using AI copilots and agents to improve delivery speed, testing, and documentation.

General Information

  • Location: Remote. Talents from the USA or Canada.
  • Overlap: 6hs with East Coast time zone, USA
  • Commitment: full-time
  • Length: 12+ months

Required Skills:

  • 3–6+ years of Salesforce development experience
  • Strong hands-on experience with Apex
  • Strong experience building Lightning Web Components (LWC)
  • Strong experience with Salesforce Flow
  • Experience with Git-based development and pull request workflows
  • Strong automated testing mindset, including unit testing and security checks
  • Experience validating Salesforce security, sharing rules, bulkification, and governor limits
  • Experience integrating Salesforce components with APIs and MuleSoft-facing solutions
  • Daily experience using AI copilots or coding agents for discovery, development, testing, and documentation
  • Ability to review and validate AI-generated code before production deployment
  • Experience participating in peer reviews, defect resolution, and production support
  • Optional Skills (not mandatory):
  • Experience with Salesforce Experience Cloud
  • Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud

Deliverables

  • Deliver Salesforce stories from a discovery-ready backlog through production, including tests and release notes
  • Build and maintain Flows, Lightning Web Components, and Apex functionality on a bi-weekly delivery cadence
  • Own pull requests, automated tests, defect fixes, and production-quality validation
  • Build API and MuleSoft-facing components in close collaboration with integration engineers
  • Use AI pair-programming for Flow, LWC, Apex, and unit-test scaffolding while independently validating production readiness
  • Add automated tests and security checks within the same pull request as the related development work
  • Validate bulkification, sharing, security, and Salesforce governor-limit compliance
  • Participate in peer reviews and the P1 on-call rotation
  • Contribute reusable AI prompts and development patterns that improve engineering quality and delivery efficiency
  • Maintain accountability for production decisions and prevent untested AI-generated code from reaching production
  • Engagement Highlights
  • Full-time and long-term engagement with an Enterprise account at Toptal.
  • Use AI copilots and coding agents as part of the daily engineering workflow.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toptal-salesforce-developers-with-ai-assisted-coding-experience

item.title: Toptal: Full-Stack E-commerce Developer with Sage X3 Experience
item.description:
Headquarters:

Summary

We are seeking a Full-Stack Developer to build or customize a dealer e-commerce platform connected to an existing Sage X3 ERP environment. The role is focused on selecting the right e-commerce approach, implementing the portal, and supporting dealer-facing workflows in a manufacturing context.

General information

This engagement centers on building an e-commerce portal for dealers on top of an existing Sage X3 ERP setup. The client is open to the e-commerce technology choice and is looking for an experienced developer who can assess the current environment, recommend an appropriate platform approach, and deliver the required solution.

The work is fully remote and involves integrating the portal with Sage X3 while supporting the underlying commerce and data flows required for dealer operations.

Tasks and Deliverables

Assess the current Sage X3 environment and recommend the e-commerce platform approach.

Build or customize a dealer e-commerce portal on top of the existing ERP.

Integrate the platform with Sage X3 using SOAP and GraphQL APIs.

Develop full-stack functionality using the selected commerce stack and supporting technologies.

Implement dealer-facing workflows, data exchange, and platform customizations required for launch.

Required experience

Strong hands-on experience with Sage X3 integration.

Proven full-stack development experience with Python and JavaScript.

Experience with Node.js, PHP, MySQL, and CSS.

Experience working with REST, SOAP and GraphQL APIs.

Nice to have:

Manufacturing industry experience.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toptal-full-stack-e-commerce-developer-with-sage-x3-experience

item.title: Sticker Mule: Software engineer
item.description:
Headquarters: New York, NY
URL: https://www.stickermule.com

Sticker Mule is building the Internet's most lucrative commerce platform by combining software, manufacturing, and AI into one fully integrated stack. No print company, or pure software company for that matter, can match what we're doing. We're privately owned, profitable, and doing 9-figures in annual revenue with no meddlesome investors.

 

How we work

  1. Small, autonomous teams that own products end-to-end.

  2. Prioritize what matters right now and pivot instantly when needed.

  3. Ship across web and mobile from the same codebase. We use Go, TypeScript, React, Expo, GraphQL, Postgres, and run on GCP.

  4. Use AI aggressively to push the limit of what we can do.

  5. Move fast, build for the masses, and deprioritize edge cases.

  6. Fully remote from 40+ countries and collaborate using Asana and Slack.

 

Requirements

  1. You are an exceptional full-stack software engineer.

  2. You use AI aggressively and write well in English.

     

What you will work on

You'll help build and scale Sticker Mule Pro — a suite of software tools for creators and businesses:

  1. Stores (Shopify alternative)

  2. AI tools (internal and customer-facing)

  3. Notify (Mailchimp alternative)

  4. Reply (Zendesk alternative)

  5. Hire Me (Contra alternative)

  6. Mobile apps

 

Compensation

  1. Salary: $150,000–$250,000 USD

  2. $20,000 signing bonus

  3. 4 weeks vacation + country-specific holidays

  4. Fully remote

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sticker-mule-software-engineer-3
